Title: Nikhil's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Nikhil - 11 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Meera - 11 years, daughter
Look: yellow frock, two plaits
3. Hema - 42 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Nikhil stands in the courtyard. Meera and Hema stand near him.]

Meera: "Nikhil, what's the plan today?"

[Nikhil folds his hands and prays.]

Nikhil: "Let's see."

[Nikhil lights a diya.]

Nikhil (laughing): "Okay, Mom."

[Meera draws a rangoli at the door.]

Nikhil (surprised): "This is amazing!"

[Nikhil paints a picture.]

Nikhil: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Nikhil draws a picture of the house.]

Nikhil: "What happened?"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Nikhil stands in the living room. Hema stands near him.]

Nikhil: "So, here we are!"

[Nikhil eats his breakfast at the table.]

Hema: "Nikhil, listen!"

[Nikhil takes a bite of his sandwich.]

Nikhil: "One more time!"

[Nikhil munches on an apple.]

Nikhil: "This is amazing!"

[Nikhil drinks a glass of water.]

Nikhil: "Careful!"

[Nikhil sips hot tea from a cup.]

Nikhil: "What happened?"

[Nikhil gulps down a glass of milk.]

Nikhil (gently): "And then?"

[Nikhil serves hot rotis to Mother.]

Nikhil: "I really enjoyed today."
